today_news.title: Andrej Karpathy built a curated video platform in a weekend using Claude and 20 years of Hacker News
today_news.summary: OpenAI co-founder Andrej Karpathy used Claude's Opus 5.5 to filter 43 million Hacker News comments into 6,454 curated videos. The result beats YouTube's own recommendations, he says.
